description: Three numbered onboarding steps with time estimates in a bordered grid, headed by a get-started button.

import { ArrowRight } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" const steps = [ { title: "Create a workspace", body: "Sign up with your work email. We import your team from Slack or Google automatically.", time: "30 sec", }, { title: "Connect a repository", body: "Pick a GitHub or GitLab repo and Relay maps your services, owners and environments.", time: "2 min", }, { title: "Ship your first preview", body: "Open a pull request and get a shareable preview URL with logs, before review even starts.", time: "4 min", }, ] export default function CallToAction13() { return (

Live in production before your coffee cools.

    {steps.map((step, i) => (
  1. {String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0")} ~{step.time}

    {step.title}

    {step.body}

    2. ))}

Total time to first deploy: about 6 minutes. Free on the Hobby plan.
